judgments.yea_description: Voted to pass H.B. 116, the Ohio Blockchain Basics Act, which barred state and local governments from blocking payments made in digital assets or taking custody of them through hardware or self-hosted wallets, and let individuals mine digital assets at home, subject to local ordinances, and businesses mine in areas zoned industrial. It passed the Ohio House 70-26.

It passed the Ohio House 70-26.
